rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH target_region AS (
  SELECT geocode_regions AS region_code
  FROM eu_territorial_units
  WHERE lower(description) LIKE '%nordjylland%' OR lower(geocode_regions) LIKE '%nordjylland%'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.acronym,
  i.short_name,
  i.country_id,
  i.geocode_regions_3,
  i.grid_id,
  i.website,
  i.db_pedia_url,
  i.wikidata_url,
  i.document_vectors
FROM institutions i
JOIN target_region tr ON tr.region_code IS NOT NULL
WHERE i.geocode_regions_3 = tr.region_code
   OR lower(i.geocode_regions_3) LIKE '%' || lower(tr.region_code) || '%'
   OR lower(i.geocode_regions_3) LIKE '%nordjylland%'
   OR lower(i.institutions_name) LIKE '%nordjylland%'
ORDER BY i.institutions_name

SELECT
  -- canonical display name for the institution
  coalesce(institutions.institutions_name, '') AS institutions_name,
  -- primary key carried through
  institutions.unics_id,
  -- country id as stored on institutions table (nullable)
  institutions.country_id,
  -- canonical 3-region geocode (use institutions value if present)
  NULLIF(trim(coalesce(institutions.geocode_regions_3, '')), '') AS geocode_regions_3,

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_with_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    CASE
      WHEN p.start_year IS NOT NULL AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL THEN (p.end_year - p.start_year)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS duration_years
  FROM projects p
)
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.duration_years
FROM projects_with_years p
WHERE p.start_year IS NOT NULL
  AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
  AND p.duration_years = (
    SELECT MAX(duration_years)
    FROM projects_with_years pw
    WHERE pw.start_year IS NOT NULL
      AND pw.end_year IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY duration_years DESC, unics_id
